response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT o.orderspivot, oe.ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions AS oe JOIN orders AS o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderspivot, oe.ordersmark, o.timespan), compared AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS tif_avg_fill, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill IS NULL, avg_fill DESC) AS fill_rank FROM per_order) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_avg_fill AS excess_fill, fill_rank FROM compared WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg_fill AND fill_rank <= 3;
